title: Transmission Timetable for the Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing
content:
How each Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate reaches the ordering state, and the business-day timetable that applies to it.

## Timetable by certificate

| Certificate | Transmission method | Transmitted within (business days after the request or correction) | Cutoff (Eastern time) | State acknowledgment normally within (business days after transmission) | Follow-up with the state after (business days without a response) | Transmissions per filing version before referral to the filings unit | Customer copy sent within (business days after acknowledgment) | Out-of-state mailing method |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal SR-22 Owner Certificate | Electronic | 1 | 16:00 | 3 | 5 | 3 | 2 | Not applicable |
| Cardinal SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate | Electronic | 1 | 16:00 | 3 | 5 | 3 | 2 | Not applicable |
| Cardinal Out-of-State SR-22 Owner Certificate | Paper mail | 3 | 16:00 | 15 | 20 | 2 | 2 | Certified mail |
| Cardinal Out-of-State SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate | Paper mail | 3 | 16:00 | 15 | 20 | 2 | 2 | Certified mail |
| Cardinal FR-44 Owner Certificate | Electronic | 1 | 16:00 | 3 | 5 | 3 | 2 | Not applicable |
| Cardinal FR-44 Owner-Operator Certificate | Electronic | 1 | 16:00 | 3 | 5 | 3 | 2 | Not applicable |

**Business calendar (every certificate):** Monday to Friday except New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day.

## Notes to the timetable

- **Cutoff.** A request received after 16:00 Eastern time counts as received on the next business day.
- **Paper certificates.** The two out-of-state certificates travel to the state agency on paper, sent by certified mail; the in-state SR-22 and FR-44 certificates are transmitted electronically and have no mailing method.
- **Attempts.** The attempt figure is the number of transmissions of one filing version made before the version is referred to the filings unit.

## Hypothetical timing illustration

A request for a Cardinal SR-22 Owner Certificate received on a Tuesday at 16:30 Eastern time, with no holiday that week, counts as received on Wednesday and is transmitted within 1 business day of Wednesday, that is, by Thursday. The same request for a Cardinal Out-of-State SR-22 Owner Certificate counts as received Wednesday and is transmitted within 3 business days, that is, by the following Monday. The days of the week are chosen for illustration only.
